_meta.title: Astronaut Vitals demonstration thresholds
_meta.notice: Demo thresholds, verify with medical sources. These illustrative bands are not clinical criteria, do not account for individual history or measurement conditions, and must not guide real astronaut care.
_meta.ageContext: Illustrative adult values only. Glucose bands assume a single demo input without meal or fasting context and are especially unsuitable for clinical interpretation.

systolic.label: Systolic blood pressure
systolic.threshold: Demo: NORMAL 90–119; WATCH 120–139; ALERT <90 or ≥140 mmHg

diastolic.label: Diastolic blood pressure
diastolic.threshold: Demo: NORMAL 60–79; WATCH 80–89; ALERT <60 or ≥90 mmHg

heartRate.label: Heart rate
heartRate.threshold: Demo resting adult band: NORMAL 60–100; WATCH 50–59 or 101–120; ALERT <50 or >120 bpm

glucose.label: Blood glucose
glucose.threshold: Demo only, meal/fasting context required: NORMAL 70–140; WATCH 54–69 or 141–199; ALERT <54 or ≥200 mg/dL

temperature.label: Body temperature
temperature.threshold: Demo adult reference: NORMAL 36.5–37.3; WATCH 35.0–36.4 or 37.4–37.9; ALERT <35.0 or ≥38.0 °C

sleepHours.label: Sleep in the last 24 hours
sleepHours.threshold: Demo adult band: NORMAL ≥7; WATCH 5–6.9; ALERT <5 h per 24 h

mood.label: Mood self-rating
mood.threshold: Demo self-rating only: NORMAL 4–5; WATCH 3; ALERT 1–2
